questions.q: What distinguishes an intercompany transaction from an intracompany transaction?
options: Intercompany transactions never involve foreign currency
An intercompany transaction crosses different legal entities; an intracompany transaction crosses balancing segment values within the same legal entity
Intracompany transactions always require approval, intercompany never does
There is no real difference, the terms are interchangeable
questions.explain: Intracompany stays within one legal entity (e.g., across divisions); intercompany crosses different legal entities in the group.

questions.q: In the LTV Manufacturing Corporation example, when the US entity allocates $4,000 of IT cost to the UK entity, what does Oracle Fusion automatically generate?
options: Nothing; the user must manually enter both sides
A single journal line with no offsetting entry
A currency revaluation entry only
An intercompany receivable in the US entity's books and an intercompany payable in the UK entity's books
questions.explain: Intercompany balancing rules generate the offsetting receivable (US) and payable (UK) lines so each entity's books independently stay in balance.

questions.q: How are intercompany balancing rules typically configured?
options: Randomly generated by the system each period
Only at the chart of accounts segment level, with no entity awareness
By pairs of legal entities (or ledgers/balancing segment values), specifying the receivable and payable accounts to use for that pair
They cannot be configured; every transaction requires custom coding
questions.explain: Balancing rules are set up once per entity pair (or similar grouping) and then applied automatically to every transaction between that pair.

questions.q: Why might an intercompany receivable and its corresponding payable fail to net to zero across the group?
options: They are designed to never match
Oracle Fusion deletes one side automatically each month
Timing differences, FX rate differences, or a manual journal posted to only one side can throw them out of balance
Because intercompany transactions are not allowed to use different currencies
questions.explain: Even though the rule generates both sides automatically, later timing, FX, or one-sided manual entries can cause the balances to diverge.

questions.q: What tool is specifically run to catch intercompany imbalances before period close?
options: The Trial Balance Report alone
The Journal Approvals workflow
The Chart of Accounts Mapping tool
The Intercompany Reconciliation Report
questions.explain: The Intercompany Reconciliation Report is run specifically to identify and resolve intercompany balance mismatches before the period closes.
